title: 'forage kitchen whitefish bay' ranking loss escalating: pos 1.4 -> 2.2, clicks -49% (505 -> 255)
detail: Last week this fell out of #1 (1.3 -> 2.0); it has now slipped further to position 2.2 and clicks halved (505 -> 255, -250). This is a genuine, worsening ranking loss on a lifeblood location query. The /locations/whitefish-bay page total still looks healthy (595 vs 574, pos 2.9 flat) only because demand shifted to variants that gained ('forage whitefish bay' +104 to 161, 'forage kitchen whitefish bay menu' +31 to 63) - masking the primary-term erosion. Something is holding the top organic/local slot on the exact city term. Action: search 'forage kitchen whitefish bay' from a Milwaukee-area IP and see who owns position 1-2 (a competitor, Yelp/DoorDash aggregator, or a Google-hosted panel); confirm the Whitefish Bay Google Business Profile is verified, primary, and category-correct; verify the page title/H1 still leads with 'Forage Kitchen Whitefish Bay'. Recovering #1 is worth ~250 clicks/28d.

title: Pewaukee down a third straight week (343 -> 297, -13%) with position flat at 3.7 - demand/SERP, not ranking
detail: /locations/pewaukee has now declined three periods running (was flagged at -29% then -24%; now -13%) while position holds flat (3.7 -> 3.7), so this remains a demand or SERP-layout problem rather than a ranking slip. Supporting signal: 'restaurants in pewaukee' dropped out of results entirely (was 5 clicks at pos 14). The decline is decelerating, which may mean it is stabilizing at a lower baseline. Action: this is now a two-week-old open item - pull the Pewaukee Google Business Profile (hours, open status, photos, review velocity) AND compare against Toast in-store sales for the period. If store sales are steady, this is pure search-visibility (map-pack reshuffle or a new local competitor) and cosmetic; if sales also fell, it is real local demand softening and worth an operator conversation.

title: /menu (pos 4.0 -> 5.2, -196 clicks) and homepage (pos 9.1 -> 10.0, -426 clicks) both softened on position
detail: Two of the highest-traffic pages lost position this period. /menu fell from 4.0 to 5.2 with clicks down 196 (3222 -> 3026) and the driving query 'forage kitchen menu' slipped 1.2 -> 1.5 (-118 clicks). The homepage lost 426 clicks and 0.9 positions. These are small percentage moves on large bases, but position drops (not just click dips) mean it is partly ranking, not just demand. Action: confirm no recent title-tag or on-page change regressed these; check that /menu still has a descriptive, query-matched <title> and that the homepage internal-links prominently to /menu and the location pages. Watch next week - if position keeps sliding it warrants a closer technical look (Core Web Vitals, a crawl/index issue).

title: 'Near me' local terms still soft (food near me pos 10.9 -> 11.8) - run the LocalBusiness schema audit
detail: Carried forward and still unresolved: 'food near me' slipped again (10.9 -> 11.8, 10.7k impr) and 'restaurants near me' worsened on position (13.9 -> 15.4) even though its clicks rose (+18). One bright spot - 'healthy food near me' gained (+40 clicks to 87, pos improved to 7.5) - shows the health-forward angle is where Forage can actually win these unbranded searches. Action (still the open task from last week): confirm every /locations/* page carries complete LocalBusiness structured data (name, address, geo coordinates, opening hours, telephone, menu URL) plus an embedded Google map, and that each Google Business Profile's category/hours/photos are current. Lean the location and homepage copy toward 'healthy'/'fresh' near-me phrasing where it fits, since that is the near-me query Forage ranks best on.

title: Champaign aggregate position slipping again (4.4 -> 6.1); Hilldale showing a variant reshuffle to watch
detail: Champaign: last week's recovery is partially reversing - the page position drifted from 4.4 to 6.1 and the branded query 'forage kitchen champaign' eased from pos 1.2 to 1.7 (still page-1, clicks up 69 -> 97, so order intent is intact). This is the second flagged period; if the non-branded position keeps sliding, refresh the page with Champaign neighborhood/campus keywords and confirm LocalBusiness schema. Hilldale: 'forage hilldale' fell hard (pos 1.5 -> 3.8, -53 clicks) BUT 'forage kitchen hilldale' simultaneously rose to #1 (+43 clicks) and the /locations/hilldale-madison-wi page is up +6 with position stable (3.4) - so this is Google reshuffling which query variant it credits, not a page problem. No action on Hilldale beyond monitoring; the page is healthy.

title: Total impressions -38% driven almost entirely by one blog post - demand/SERP, not a site-wide ranking loss
detail: Site impressions fell 1.35M -> 829k, but ~366k of that is a single post: /blogs/fermented-food dropped from ~508k to 142k impressions while its position barely moved (8.7 -> 8.6). Stable rank + collapsing impressions = a demand or SERP-feature pullback (a large informational query it was surfacing for lost volume or got absorbed by an AI overview), not lost rankings. Non-branded clicks are down only 3.3% (1792 -> 1732), confirming the impression drop is low-value. Do NOT chase this. If you want to defend non-branded, refresh the 2-3 highest-value posts (forbidden-rice, fermented-food, kale-vs-spinach): update publish dates, add/refresh FAQ schema, and add internal links from the homepage and /menu. Standing low-priority gap unchanged: /locations/state-street-madison-wi remains the weakest location page (51 clicks) despite strong Madison intent resolving to the homepage - add a prominent homepage link to State Street.
